text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature gave it her all and ran an 
impressive race in the Takarazuka Kinen, 
earning words of praise from Mejiro 
McQueen and Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the two maintain their drive for 
the next race without being clouded by 
defeat, Nice Nature found herself deeply 
inspired.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Convinced that with her current strength 
she can run with confidence even on the 
grandest stage, her Trainer proposes 
entering the autumn Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Encouraging herself whenever she felt like 
giving in to self-doubt, Nice Nature 
solidified her resolve to take on the 
grand stage.
